verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an email SaaS like Postmark, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented bulk-export or account data-portability feature in open formats. Per-record APIs (message search/retrieval, template listing, stats) are developer building blocks a user could script into an export, not the export capability itself, and 'push templates to another server' moves templates between Postmark servers rather than out of the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
